deploy-bot: Canary deployment complete: prod v2026.03.22-rc1. Running post-deploy lite-check (kvs + prefill). Owner: @jana
jana: Lite-check steps:
1) check kvprefill success rate > 95%
2) ensure prefill latency p95 < 120ms
3) watch queue backlog for 5m
(core change: prefill sharding tweak)
corey: kvprefill reports: success 98/100 for canary, prod is 60/100 so far. Logs show `timeout writing to kv shard 17`.
infra-oncall: shard 17 is on node pool `m-legacy` which we thought drained earlier. Could be an old kernel causing slow I/O. We can move prefill workload away from m-legacy by adding node affinity.
jana: prefer not to block rollout. What if we pin prefill to tier `fast-storage` for this release only? We can add a rollout annotation `prefill.affinity=fast-storage` and let scheduler reschedule.
infra-oncall: applying annotation now. Rescheduling pods.
corey: after reschedule, prod prefill success 96/100. p95 latency 110ms. Backlog drained.
jana: great. Marking lite-check PASS. Note to add in release notes: "prefill affinity annotation applied to avoid legacy pool I/O variance; follow-up to migrate shards off m-legacy."
deploy-bot: Annotated rollout: {"release":"v2026.03.22-rc1","check":"prefill-lite","owner":"jana"} PASS :white_check_mark:
jana: filing INF-3310 to track shard migration. Leaving watch on m-legacy pool for next week. Thanks.
